# forgejo_team_repository (Resource)

Assign a repository to an organization team. The team and repository must belong to the same organization. The team must have `includes_all_repositories = false`; this resource manages an explicit association. Permissions are configured on the team. Destroying this resource removes the association without deleting the team or repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forgejo_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "forgejo_repository" "example" {
  owner = forgejo_organization.example.name
  name  = "example-repo"
}

resource "forgejo_team" "example" {
  organization_id           = forgejo_organization.example.id
  name                      = "readers"
  includes_all_repositories = false
  permission                = "read"
  units_map = {
    "repo.code" = "read"
  }
}

resource "forgejo_team_repository" "example" {
  team_id       = forgejo_team.example.id
  repository_id = forgejo_repository.example.id
}

# Import an existing association using its numeric team and repository IDs.
import {
  id = "42/123"
  to = forgejo_team_repository.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the repository. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `team_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the organization team. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Association identifier in team_id/repository_id format.
